title: Degenerations of the fourth order $q$-Garnier system arising from confluences in quivers
summary: The $q$-Garnier system was first proposed by Sakai, and alternative directions for its discrete time evolutions were provided by Nagao and Yamada. Recently, it was shown that all of those evolution directions are derived from a birational representation of an extended affine Weyl group which arises from the cluster algebraic construction established by Masuda, Okubo and Tsuda. In this article, we investigate a degeneration structure of the fourth order $q$-Garnier system by using confluences in quivers.
